one_sentence_summary: Compare baseline and smoothed robot policies.
goal: Evaluate whether action smoothing improves pick-and-place behavior-cloning success.
current_stage: Comparing baseline and smoothed policy variants.
confirmed_findings: Baseline success was 61% and smoothed-policy success was 68%.
The smoothed policy has slower recovery from failed grasps.
Smoothing creates a stability versus rapid-correction trade-off during recovery.
open_questions: Can adaptive smoothing preserve stability while improving recovery?
next_actions: Evaluate smoothing only during the approach phase.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The experiment log records success rates and failed-grasp recovery.
Failure analysis describes the stability and recovery trade-off.
Next steps record the approach-phase evaluation.
